# Section 030 Knowledge Check: Right-Sizing And Autoscaling

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Create an autoscaling/v2 HPA with a CPU utilisation target and minReplicas and maxReplicas
- Calculate the desired replica count from current and target utilisation with the HPA formula
- Generate load from shuttle and watch the HPA scale up and back down with kubectl get hpa --watch
- Diagnose an HPA that shows unknown targets because the pods have no CPU requests or metrics-server is missing
- Slow down scale-down with behavior.scaleDown stabilizationWindowSeconds and policies
- Create a VerticalPodAutoscaler in Off mode and read its target, lowerBound and upperBound recommendations
- Compare a container's requests with its recommendation and measured usage to find over- and under-provisioned workloads
- Apply a recommendation by updating the Deployment's requests and confirm the new QoS class and node allocation
- Bound recommendations with resourcePolicy minAllowed and maxAllowed
- Choose between VPA update modes and explain why VPA and HPA must not both act on CPU for the same workload
